    • deleteSpecialOpeningTimeQuery

      public boolean deleteSpecialOpeningTimeQuery(data.OpeningHoursPerDay openingHours)
      Deletes specific special opening hours for a specific date. Implements STRICT "All-or-Nothing" logic: If even ONE slot is not found, it stops, rolls back, and returns false. * @param openingHours The OpeningHoursPerDay object containing the LocalDate and list of slots.
      Returns:
      true if ALL slots were successfully deleted, false otherwise.

    • deleteOpeningTimeQuery

      public boolean deleteOpeningTimeQuery(data.OpeningHours openingHours)
      Deletes specific weekly opening hours. Implements STRICT "All-or-Nothing" logic: If even ONE slot is not found (rowsAffected == 0), it immediately stops, rolls back, and returns false. * @param openingHours The OpeningHours object containing the day string and list of slots to delete.
      Returns:
      true if ALL slots were successfully deleted, false otherwise.

    • updateOpeningTimeQuery

      public boolean updateOpeningTimeQuery(data.OpeningHours openingHours)
      Adds new weekly opening hours for a specific day of the week. This method inserts new slots without deleting existing ones. * @param openingHours The OpeningHours object containing the day string and list of slots.
      Returns:
      true if the insertion was successful, false otherwise.

      public ArrayList<ArrayList<Object>> getAllReservationsQueryByDay(LocalDate day)

    • getOpeningHoursByDate

      public data.OpeningHoursPerDay getOpeningHoursByDate(data.OpeningHoursPerDay openingHours)
      Retrieves the effective opening hours for a specific date, prioritizing specific overrides over the general schedule.

      Logic Flow: 1. Special Hours: Checks for specific date overrides first. If an entry exists where start equals end time, the day is marked as explicitly CLOSED. 2. Weekly Hours: If no special hours exist for the date, falls back to the standard weekly schedule for that day of the week.

      Parameters:
      openingHours - The OpeningHoursPerDay object containing the date to query.
      Returns:
      The same OpeningHoursPerDay object populated with the found TimeSlots, or with a null list if the restaurant is closed or on error.

    • createNewReservation

      public boolean createNewReservation(data.TableReservation res)
      Inserts a new reservation record into the database and updates the provided object with server-generated fields.

      Upon successful insertion, this method automatically: 1. Retrieves the auto-generated reservationId. 2. Fetches the default status and creation timestamp assigned by the database. 3. Updates the passed TableReservation object with these values.

      Parameters:
      res - The TableReservation object containing the reservation details (customer, time, diners).
      Returns:
      true if the reservation was successfully created and the object updated, false on database error.

    • closeResources

      private static void closeResources(PreparedStatement stmt, ResultSet rs)
      Utility method to safely close JDBC resources (Statement and ResultSet).

      This method performs null checks and suppresses any SQLExceptions that might occur during closing. This ensures that exceptions in the finally block do not mask the original exception from the try block.

      Parameters:
      stmt - The PreparedStatement to close.
      rs - The ResultSet to close.

    • getWaitingListQuery

      public ArrayList<ArrayList<Object>> getWaitingListQuery()
      Retrieves the entire waiting list from the database, ordered by entry time (FIFO).

      The list is sorted in ascending order of entryTimeToList, ensuring that customers who arrived first appear at the top of the list.

      Returns:
      An ArrayList of ArrayLists, where each inner list contains the raw data fields (ID, reservation ref, group size, times, status, type) of a single waiting entry, or null on error.

    • deleteFromWaitList

      public boolean deleteFromWaitList(data.WaitList waiter)
      Performs a logical deletion of a customer from the waiting list by marking them as cancelled.

      Instead of physically removing the row from the database, this method updates the status to 'cancelled' and sets the exit time to the current server timestamp. This preserves the record for historical analysis.

      Parameters:

      Returns:
      true if the record was successfully found and updated, false otherwise.

    • closeRestaurantOnSpecialDayQuery

      public boolean closeRestaurantOnSpecialDayQuery(data.OpeningHoursPerDay openingHours)
      Explicitly closes the restaurant on a specific date by setting its hours to 00:00-00:00.

      This method performs an atomic transaction: 1. Deletes any existing special hours entries for the target date (cleaning the slate). 2. Inserts a single new record with openingTime = 00:00 and closingTime = 00:00.

      Parameters:
      openingHours - The OpeningHoursPerDay object containing the target date and the "closed" time slot.
      Returns:
      true if the operation (delete + insert) was completed successfully, false otherwise.

      public boolean updateSpecialOpeningTimeQuery(data.OpeningHoursPerDay oldHours, data.OpeningHoursPerDay newHours)
      Updates a specific special opening hour record, changing its start and end times.

      This method identifies the row to update by matching the date and the original opening/closing times. It then updates that specific row with the new opening and closing times provided.

      Parameters:
      oldHours - The OpeningHoursPerDay object containing the date and the original time slot (used for the WHERE clause).
      newHours - The OpeningHoursPerDay object containing the new time slot (used for the SET clause).

    • getReservationsByDateRangeQuery

      public ArrayList<ArrayList<Object>> getReservationsByDateRangeQuery(Timestamp startDate, Timestamp endDate)
      Retrieves all reservation records that fall within a specific date range.

      The query filters based on the reservationDate column. It is inclusive, meaning it searches for records where the date is greater than or equal to the start and less than or equal to the end.

      Parameters:
      startDate - The beginning of the date range (Timestamp).
      endDate - The end of the date range (Timestamp).
      Returns:
      An ArrayList of ArrayLists, where each inner list contains the raw data fields of a single reservation. Returns null on connection error.

    • getReservationsByAttributeQuery

      public ArrayList<ArrayList<Object>> getReservationsByAttributeQuery(String attribute, Object value)
      Retrieves reservations matching a specific dynamic criterion.

      Security & Safety Measures:

      • SQL Injection Prevention: The column name (attribute) is validated against a hardcoded whitelist (Switch statement). Raw strings are never concatenated into the query.
      • Type Validation: The value parameter is explicitly checked to ensure it is either an Integer or a String before execution.

      Parameters:
      attribute - The name of the database column (e.g., "status", "tableId").
      value - The value to search for. Must be an Integer or a String.
      Returns:
      An ArrayList of ArrayLists containing the raw data, or null on error/invalid type.
